newsitem.title: USA: Fedders unit to issue $100mln in sr notes.
newsitem.headline: Fedders unit to issue $100mln in sr notes.

text.p: Fedders Corp said Monday its wholly owned subsidiary Fedders North America Inc agreed to issue $100 million principal amount of 9.375 percent senior subordinated notes due 2007.

The air conditioner maker said it will use the offering's proceeds to redeem Fedders Corp's 8.5 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2012 in the aggregate amount of about $22 million; to fund its $50 million stock repurchase program; and for general corporate purposes.
Fedders, which guarantees the new notes on a senior subordinated basis, expected to close the deal August 18.
